lessons: Acceptance criteria 3 and the ticket's Scope both forbid changing any fixture assertion. But tests/test_journal.py:39 test_append_round_trips_envelope appends and asserts body={"kind":"confirm"} as a literal, and no engine code writes 'confirm'.

With 'confirm' outside SIGNAL_NAMES, the new append validation refuses that fixture. Renaming only the appended body breaks the unchanged equality assertion. The attempt reproduced this: migrating to drain_handoff made the test fail.

Re-author the ticket so a migration may change an assertion's expected signal name to match the migrated append, and nothing else. Or have the fixture compare against the same variable it appends, so the name lives in one place.

Before re-authoring, grep every EventType.SIGNAL append under tests/ for assertions that repeat a literal unlisted name ('unrelated', 'late', 'unknown', 'spec_gap_hold', {}, {"n":...}). That way the allowance covers every such case, not just test_journal.
